notes: Cheap 6-in-1 RGBWAUV par can. Confirmed against the fixture's printed manual. It stores two separate DMX start addresses on the unit itself: 'd0xx' for 6-channel mode and 'A0xx' for 10-channel mode -- make sure you program the address matching the mode you patch here.

channels.label: Function
channels.notes: 000-050 = plain CH1-CH8 DMX control. 051-100 = 8 built-in color presets (selected by CH10). 101-150 = jump chase. 151-200 = gradient chase. 201-250 = pulse chase. 251-255 = sound-reactive. Stay in 0-50 to keep the fixture responding to the other channels.

channels.label: Speed
channels.notes: Auto-program speed; irrelevant while Function is in 0-50.
